headline: Leafs’ Sissons exits game due to lower-body injury
take:
Daily Faceoff reports Colton Sissons left Sunday's game against New Jersey with a lower-body injury, and it isn't clear yet why he didn't return.

The bigger worry in Toronto isn't one depth forward. The Leafs are 8-9-2 with 47% of the expected goals (a measure of chance quality, 50% is an even split), and they've scored 6.5 more goals than those chances usually produce. A team being outplayed and finishing above its chances is a team whose record could get worse before it gets better. Sissons' minutes are the kind a coach can patch from the press box; the shot share is not. Until there's word on how long he's out, we'll hold off on guessing who gets his ice time.
